title: An invisible mass map
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Lensing reveals mass through its effect on background light, including mass that emits little or no light. It does not by itself identify the particle nature of dark matter.

misconception: A learner may choose: It directly photographs dark matter particles
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: How can gravitational lensing help map dark matter?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: How can gravitational lensing help map dark matter? The distortion of background light reveals intervening mass. Lensing reveals mass through its effect on background light, including mass that emits little or no light. It does not by itself identify the particle nature of dark matter.
Visual caption: Distortion traces mass. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: How can gravitational lensing help map dark matter?
options: The distortion of background light reveals intervening mass
It directly photographs dark matter particles
It measures only the brightness of nearby stars
